name: bookmark-digest
description: Bookmark Digest - Self-hosted bookmarking and reading service

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node scripts/setup.mjs
scripts.dev: node scripts/setup.mjs && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm --prefix backend start
